scope: bounded development measurement; not an official benchmark or independent replication
metrics_after: all twenty output attempts for a prompt are durably locked

invirtuogen_paper_table_4.role: paper-reported three-run aggregate; unmatched sample budget

genmol_v2_author_readme.role: author-reported GenMol-V2 one-step README row; distinct from paper V1

comparison_rule: report macro means and signed differences to each comparator separately; no formal win from 200 attempts
morphing: alias only when all ten supplied input pairs match exactly; no duplicated samples or independent claim
recovery: reuse completed attempts with exact RNG chain; interrupted starts fail closed without automatic regeneration
immutable_dependencies: same sampler, prior, catalog, checkpoint, limits and softmax as passing support; exact source hashes checked before and after run
